name: context7
description: Up-to-date library documentation and code examples for any package

name: obscura
description: Built-in Obscura browser MCP — navigate, click, fill, type, eval JS, inspect network and console. Zero setup beyond installing Obscura.
setup_instructions:
Install Obscura (Rust):
  cargo install obscura

Or download a pre-built binary from:
  https://github.com/h4ckf0r0day/obscura/releases

name: ui-inspector
description: Visual UI/UX layer on top of Obscura — screenshots, ARIA accessibility tree, computed CSS, axe-core a11y audit. Requires 'obscura serve' running (started by start-services.sh).
setup_instructions:
Run setup once:
  cd ${DEVEXP_DIR}/mcps/ui-inspector && ./setup.sh

Then start Obscura CDP server before each session:
  ./start-services.sh
